messages:
Sam: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands on security/compliance items. Using this thread to track owners and next steps.
Jordan: I'll own the SOC2 evidence matrix and look into automating snapshots. Target: Wed EOD.
Anna: Infra will publish a VPC peering playbook (subnets, routes, example Terraform). ETA: Fri.
Leah: Product will collect feature gaps that affect controls (logging defaults, PII handling). I'll post a list.
Ravi: I'll sweep recent routes for missing logging and post findings tomorrow.
Jordan: For audit logs: compliance asked for retention options (90/365/7y) + export path. I'll prototype S3 export with Object Lock + signed hashes.
Sam: Leadership lean is 365d default. Please include cost estimates per 1000 accounts.
Anna: Infra note: lifecycle rules will be added to move older archives to Glacier; need Legal signoff before enabling Object Lock.
Leah: We'll add a PII redaction guideline and a minimal logging schema draft.
Jordan: BYOK roadmap: Q2 alpha for Dedicated/Private, Q3 for hosted patterns. Will include limitations (cross-region, backups).
OpsBot: Created ticket SEC-2026-042: evidence-automation. Tagging @Jordan @Anna.
Anna: Seeing one failed export job this morning, investigating; will post root cause in #eng-oncall.
Ravi: Suggest weekly 30-min sync for 3 weeks to keep momentum. Tue 9am PT?
Sam: Schedule it. Leah/Jordan/Anna/Ravi accept invite.
Jordan: I'll drop the SOC2 matrix and S3 example in #eng-infra and tag Compliance tomorrow.
Leah: I'll compile a single follow-up doc with owners and links and attach here when ready. :thumbsup:
